Square Peg LabsYou build it. We put it on the menu.

Five benches, five things you can design out of what is actually in our kitchens and behind our bar. We read every entry, and the ones we pick go on the menu with your name beside them.

  1. Step 1 Build it Pick a sauce, a cheese, up to four toppings and a finish. Everything on the list is something our kitchens already stock, so the one we pick is a pizza we can actually make.
  2. Step 2 Name it This is the part people remember. Keep it clean — a person reads every entry.
  3. Step 3 It goes on the menu The one we choose runs the following month as a limited-time special across all ten Square Pegs, credited to whoever built it.
5 benches, not one

Pizza, Pasta, Sandwich, Salad, Drink — every one of them is a thing you can put on our menu. Pick a bench.
